desk.headline: Adjusted EPS up 12% to 201 USc and HEPS up 33% to 160 USc as Tencent and buybacks offset heavy food-delivery spending; revenue up 59% to $5.7bn; second half expected to be stronger

other.label: Ecosystem adjusted EBITDA
other.change: from $530m; includes $344m invested in iFood and Just Eat Takeaway.com

other.label: Prosus share buyback in the half
Cash and short-term investments
other.change: against $18.0bn of interest-bearing debt incl. leases

results: Revenue rose 59% to $5.7bn, mostly thanks to the Just Eat Takeaway.com and Despegar acquisitions; growth was 10% in local currency excluding deals.
Adjusted EPS grew 12% to 201 USc, driven mainly by a bigger Tencent contribution and helped by share buybacks; HEPS rose to 160 USc from 120 USc.
Ecosystem profit (adjusted EBITDA) slipped to $492m from $530m because Prosus put $344m into iFood and Just Eat Takeaway.com; iFood's profit fell to $28m.
Classifieds business OLX was the standout, lifting adjusted EBITDA 30% to $300m at a 51% margin; payments firm PayU turned positive at $12m.
The group swung to a $133m operating loss, and EPS fell to 193 USc from 253 USc; free cash flow was $1.06bn.

guidance.summary: Prosus expects profitability and cash flow to improve in the second half and aims to return to adjusted EBITDA growth in FY28. It guides to more than $100m of FY27 adjusted EBITDA at iFood and about $100m at Just Eat Takeaway.com, excluding once-off costs.

items.metric: Just Eat Takeaway.com adjusted EBITDA (excl. once-off costs)

points: CEO Fabricio Bloisi said FY27 was meant to be "a year of execution, and we are delivering."
CFO Nico Marais expects profit and cash flow to improve in the second half, citing efficiency gains at iFood and Just Eat Takeaway.com.
Management stressed the $5bn FY27 buyback, with more than 1 billion Prosus shares bought back so far.
Just Eat Takeaway.com orders grew in September for the first time in 55 months, the company highlighted.
Food spending is framed as a deliberate investment year, with a return to profit growth targeted for FY28.
call.source: Prosus media release (25 Nov 2026) and Investing.com coverage of the results presentation (25 Nov 2026)

watch: Whether iFood and Just Eat Takeaway.com profits recover in the second half as promised.
Delivery of the remaining FY27 buyback and how it is funded (Tencent share sales versus other disposals).
The size of Tencent's earnings contribution, which drove most of the adjusted EPS growth.
